## Behavior

Describe the problem and the resulting user-visible behavior. Note any
configuration migration, runtime asset, licensing, or packaging change.

## Validation

List executed checks and any missing checks. Include a failing-before regression
for a bug fix; for an audible one, name the document or test that states the
intended output. For an audible transition fix, add a deterministic test showing
steady-state output unchanged and the artifact smaller. For a tuning change,
paste the bench report, before and after, and confirm the invariant tests pass.
Confirm the diff contains no recordings, private diagnostics, credentials, or
generated release binaries.
